abilities.name: Radiant Lash
abilities.description: A whip of light down a line: enemies in it take 14, allies in it heal 12. Fire it through your frontliner at the enemy behind them — the Mender's auto does Mender work.

abilities.name: Mending Light
abilities.description: Heal allies in the aimed area for 25. Aim it at your own square when fighting alone. Prep phase — lands before this turn's damage.

abilities.name: Glimmer Step
abilities.description: Flash to a square within 4 and gain a 15-point shield for the turn. The escape that keeps a healer alive in a duel.

abilities.name: Dazzling Ray
abilities.description: 12 damage and Weaken for a turn. Lumen's real defensive stat — make them hit like a Support.

ultimate.name: Sanctuary
ultimate.description: Consecrate the aimed area: allies within it heal 40 and gain Might for a turn. Prep phase — it lands before the burst that was supposed to kill them. (100 energy)
